raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.2.3" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-treeheatr
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/treeheatr_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/treeheatr/treeheatr_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 641bec9b5e2a9ef1227efa3035db848a9218e45fb997cece467456c5250fd1bf

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-cluster
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggnewscale
    - r-ggparty
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-gtable
    - r-partykit
    - r-seriation
    - r-tidyr
    - r-yardstick
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-cluster
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggnewscale
    - r-ggparty
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-gtable
    - r-partykit
    - r-seriation
    - r-tidyr
    - r-yardstick

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('treeheatr')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('treeheatr')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://trang1618.github.io/treeheatr/index.html, https://trang1618.github.io/treeheatr-manuscript/
  license: MIT
  summary: Creates interpretable decision tree visualizations with the data represented as a heatmap at the tree's leaf nodes. 'treeheatr' utilizes the customizable 'ggparty' package for drawing decision trees.
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
